Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.message.api

Class Messaging

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.message.api.Messaging
public final class Messaging extends Object
Per-plugin messaging manager. Use forPlugin(JavaPlugin) to obtain the messaging instance and register custom MessageProviders. Placed in `message.api` so the manager and its interface can be extracted without pulling in implementation details.
